column1: # Altin Peak: the miner's condition after the rescue.

column3:
I heard the rocks fall.
I thought my friends
were buried for good.{page_break}My hands won't stop
shaking yet.{end_wait}
He's heard us.\nGive him a moment\nto settle down.{end_wait}
We got the others out.\nWe'll get you out too.{end_wait}
I know I should move.\nCould you stay with me\na little longer?{end_now}
Thank you. I can feel\nmy legs again.\nI'll be all right.{end_wait}
I'll walk beside you.\nLean on me if you need to.\nLet's get outside.{end_wait}
